basic_details.job_title: RDWU Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 3 Posts

qualification.details: Must have experience on works relating to Accounts/Establishment/Departments etc. in the University/Govt. Offices/Govt. Colleges. Must have retired on attaining the age of superannuation from University or Government and below the age of 65 years. The candidates must be in good health. There should be no departmental proceedings or criminal cases against the candidates.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated remuneration applicable as per F.D.O.M. No. 24533/F dt. 29.09.2022
salary_details.details: Consolidated remuneration is applicable as per F.D.O.M. No. 24533/F dt. 29.09.2022.

how_to_apply: Go to the official website at https://rdwu.ac.in to download the format of the application form.
Fill in the application form in the given format.
Gather all required original certificates and a set of Xerox copies for verification.
Attend the walk-in interview on 09.10.2026 at 11:00 A.M. at the Controller of Examination Board Room, Rama Devi Women's University, Vidya Vihar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha-751022.
Submit the filled-in application form along with requisite documents during the interview.
important_instructions: Posts are purely temporary. Appointment will be given on contractual basis for a period of one year or till joining of regular staff whichever is earlier. The service can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason thereof. No TA/ DA will be paid for the purpose of attending interview. The University reserves the right to cancel whole or part of the walk-in-interview at any time without assigning the reason thereof.

content_sections.heading: RDWU Junior Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available for the post of Junior Assistant.

content_sections.heading: RDWU Junior Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Must have experience on works relating to Accounts/Establishment/Departments etc. in the University/Govt. Offices/Govt. Colleges. Must have retired on attaining the age of superannuation from University or Government and below the age of 65 years. The candidates must be in good health. There should be no departmental proceedings or criminal cases against the candidates.

rows.qualification_required: B.A./B.Sc./B.Com. with relevant experience in Finance/Accounts/Handling University Establishment/Offices. Preference will be given to candidates having Computer Literacy and previous work experience in Establishment/Finance Departments of Universities/Govt. Colleges.

content_sections.heading: RDWU Junior Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: Consolidated remuneration is applicable as per F.D.O.M. No. 24533/F dt. 29.09.2022.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RDWU Junior Assistant
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at https://rdwu.ac.in to download the format of the application form. Fill in the application form in the given format. Gather all required original certificates and a set of Xerox copies for verification. Attend the walk-in interview on 09.10.2026 at 11:00 A.M. at the Controller of Examination Board Room, Rama Devi Women's University, Vidya Vihar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha-751022. Submit the filled-in application form along with requisite documents during the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form in the given format HSC or equivalent certificate as a proof of age and qualification Recent photograph (02 nos.) Experience certificate (In case of other officers) Relieve Order from the last organization on superannuation Last Pay Certificate Proof of Computer Proficiency

content_sections.heading: RDWU Junior Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Posts are purely temporary. Appointment will be given on contractual basis for a period of one year or till joining of regular staff whichever is earlier. The service can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason thereof. No TA/ DA will be paid for the purpose of attending interview. The University reserves the right to cancel whole or part of the walk-in-interview at any time without assigning the reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is RDWU Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Rama Devi Women’s University to engage retired Government servants, University, and College employees as Junior Assistants on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Junior Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 09.10.2026 at 11:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in the Controller of Examination Board Room, Rama Devi Women’s University, Vidya Vihar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha-751022.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A./B.Sc./B.Com. degree with relevant experience in Finance/Accounts/Handling University Establishment/Offices.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must have retired on attaining the age of superannuation from a University or Government service and must be below the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contractual engagement?
faq.answer: The appointment will be given on a contractual basis for a period of one year or till the joining of regular staff, whichever is earlier.
